Alternative.description: A supply concept compared in the study. One of them is the baseline.
Alternative.title: Alternative

Connection.description: A supply and return node pair at which a plant can exchange heat with a network.
Connection.title: Connection

CostItem.description:
One line of the cost ledger.

``asset_id`` and ``cost_owner`` exist so that a well, pump or exchanger already costed by
the source model is not added again downstream.
CostItem.title: CostItem

Dataset.description: One immutable version of a source file or package, identified by its checksum.
Dataset.title: Dataset

Depth.description: A depth together with its kind: true vertical depth or measured length along the well.
Depth.title: Depth

Elevation.description: A height together with its vertical datum.
Elevation.title: Elevation

Geometry.description: A GeoJSON geometry with its coordinate reference system, for example ``EPSG:25832``.
Geometry.title: Geometry

Network.description: A district heating network with separate supply and return circuits.
Network.title: Network

heat_transfer_coefficient_w_m2_k.title: Heat Transfer Coefficient W M2 K

OperatingScenario.description:
Demand, source availability, temperature requirements, tariffs and dispatch policy.

Demand, tariffs and availability must cover the same intervals. That is checked against the
actual series by ``validate_scenario``.
OperatingScenario.title: OperatingScenario

Pressure.description: A pressure together with its reference.
Pressure.title: Pressure

Route.description:
A corridor between a site and a connection.

Trench length and pipe lengths are stored separately so that costs cannot be counted twice.
Route.title: Route

SeriesRef.description: A time series inside a registered dataset.
SeriesRef.title: SeriesRef

SiteConstraint.description: One documented site criterion, for example a permit or a setback.
SiteConstraint.title: SiteConstraint

Study.description: A declared study inside a project. All candidates and documents belong to one.
Study.title: Study

SuccessDefinition.description: The event that counts as geological success (specification 14.2).
SuccessDefinition.title: SuccessDefinition

UncertainVariable.description:
One uncertain input.

A range alone does not imply a probability distribution. A variable is either a scenario set
without probabilities or a named distribution with its own evidence.
UncertainVariable.title: UncertainVariable

WellScenario.description: One subsurface concept for a site: target, wells and reservoir parameters.
WellScenario.title: WellScenario
